_description: 10 complete Puzzle Module experiences covering all 9 PRD occasions plus one bonus Birthday variant. Each has exactly 9 questions (Business Rule #1), up to 3 clues each (#2), one experience-level partnerHelpChallenge (#5), a welcome note and a completion message. Status values span the full lifecycle (draft, published, in_progress, completed, archived) for UI/QA coverage. Image paths reference docs/puzzle-module/test-data/images/.

experiences.welcomeNote: Hey Annie, three years ago today I promised to make every day feel like this one. Before I say anything else, I need you to prove you remember us as well as I do. Nine pieces, nine memories. Ready?
experiences.completionMessage: You remembered every single one — of course you did. Happy anniversary, my love. Here's to the fourth year, and every one after it.
experiences.partnerHelpChallenge: Stuck? Ask Vikram directly — but he's only answering if you bring him a cup of filter coffee first. ☕

questions.prompt: Where did we go on our very first date?
clues: It's a big green space in the city we met in.
We shared street-side cotton candy there.
It has a famous bandstand where we sat and talked for two hours.

questions.prompt: What did I spill on you the first time we met?
clues: It was hot, and I apologized way too much.
It came in a paper cup from the campus canteen.
You still tease me about my clumsy hands.

questions.prompt: What's the name of the restaurant where I proposed?
clues: It's right by the water.
We could hear the boats from our table.
The waiter brought out a surprise dessert with the ring on it.

questions.prompt: What song played during our first dance at the wedding?
clues: It's from a movie with Aditya Roy Kapur.
You cried during the second verse.
We still play it every anniversary.

questions.prompt: What nickname did I give you in our first month of dating?
clues: It's a shorter version of your name.
I started using it after a road trip.
Only I'm allowed to call you that.

questions.prompt: Which city did we honeymoon in?
clues: It's an island.

You nearly missed the flight back.

questions.prompt: What's our favorite weekend breakfast spot?
clues: It's near our old apartment.

We've been going since we were dating.

questions.prompt: What do we call each other on bad days?

Your mother uses a similar word for your father.
We started saying it after a silly fight in year one.

questions.prompt: What's the one thing I promised you on our wedding day?
questions.correctAnswer: To make you laugh every single day
clues: It was part of my vow.
I still try to keep it even when we argue.
You reminded me of it just last week.

experiences.welcomeNote: Happy birthday, Priya! Before your cake, you've got homework — nine questions about us. Let's see how much attention you've actually been paying. 😉
experiences.completionMessage: You know us better than I thought. Happy birthday — the real surprise is waiting for you tonight.
experiences.partnerHelpChallenge: Text Arjun 'I forgot' and he'll tell you — but only after you send him a selfie with the biggest pout you can manage.

questions.prompt: What's the name of the café where we had our first coffee date?

questions.prompt: What did I gift you on your last birthday?

questions.prompt: Where do we always go for your birthday dinner?
clues: It's a brewery.

questions.prompt: What ice cream flavor do I always surprise you with?
clues: It's rich and dark.

questions.prompt: What movie did we watch on our first at-home date night?

questions.prompt: What's your go-to karaoke song?
clues: It's from Jab We Met.

I still don't know all the lyrics, and you know it.

questions.prompt: What's the promise I made for this birthday?
clues: It involves packing a bag.
I've been hinting about the mountains.
You'll find out exactly where once you finish this puzzle.
